params.body:
## No dd() on a live path

`app/` held eight calls to `dd()`. Each one ends the process with a dump page (or a dump on the console), so any of them on a reachable path is a crash that also prints internal data.

- **`VehicleRealGarantService::getPrograms`**: four `dd()` and five `echo`/`print_r` checkpoints behind `?debug=1|programs|2|3|4`. The route that calls it, `real-garant/{id}`, is public (the dealer's website asks it for the warranty block), so anyone adding `?debug=programs` stopped the request and received RealGarant's program list. The checkpoints keep their conditions and now write the same data with `Log::debug`; the method returns its normal answer. `RealGarantDebugDoesNotStopTheRequestTest` runs every checkpoint against a stubbed partner and asserts nothing is echoed, one debug line is logged and the answer still comes back.
- **`VehicleRealGarantService::getOffer`** (`dd($offer)`): no caller anywhere, and it called `createContractOfferJson` with three of its four required arguments (a PHPStan baseline entry), so it could not have run. Removed.
- **`App\Observers\SettingObserver`** (`dd($setting)` on creating `ai_dealer_real_garant` / `ai_dealer_flexlease`): never registered (only `Vehicle`, `Dealer` and `Transport` are observed), so it never ran; registering it would have turned the AI settings tab into a dump page. The class held nothing else and is removed. `AnAiSettingIsSavedWithoutADumpTest` pins that both settings can be created and that nothing listens on `created` for settings. CLAUDE.md listed it as a live observer; corrected.
- **`stocklist:removeAllFailedVehiclesToNederlandMobiel`** (two `dd($response)`): stopped after the first vehicle, and after the loop re-sent the last vehicle's delete without its context. Now every failed vehicle gets one delete and one output line, a failure on one does not stop the rest, the duplicate call is gone, and the exit code is `FAILURE` when any failed. Fixes bevinding gefaalde-wagens-verwijderen-stopte-na-een-wagen (R P3-5.12). `RemoveFailedNederlandMobielVehiclesTest` covers both outcomes with a mocked `OwnStockService`.

The comment mentioning `dd('jip')` in `AdminSettingsController` is left as is.

## Quality ratchets

`resources/css/refresh.css` is a transition layer meant to shrink as screens move to Tailwind. CLAUDE.md described it as 4,350 lines; it is 6,134, because nothing measured it. `tests/Unit/QualityRatchetTest.php` now counts five things against a committed budget in `tests/quality-ratchet.json`, in the spirit of `phpstan-baseline.neon`:

| metric | budget | rule |
|---|---|---|
| `refresh_css_lines` | 6134 | newline characters in refresh.css (`wc -l`) |
| `refresh_css_important` | 473 | `!important` in refresh.css |
| `blade_onclick` | 249 | `onclick=` in `resources/views/**/*.blade.php` |
| `blade_files_using_jquery` | 73 | blade files that call jQuery after Blade and HTML comments are stripped: `$(`, `$.` + lowercase letter, or `jQuery(`/`jQuery.`, with no word character or `$` right before the `$` |
| `app_dd_dump` | 0 | global `dd()`/`dump()` calls in `app/`, read with PHP's tokenizer (comments, strings and `->dump()` do not count) |

A count above its budget fails and names what grew and where to look. A count below its budget fails too and says which number to lower, so the pull request that improves something also locks it in. It is a plain PHPUnit test (no database, no app boot), so it runs in the existing test job. The jQuery rule counts inline handlers such as `onclick="$('#tab').val(1)"` and does not count prose like "no jQuery" in a comment; PHP never writes `$(` or `$.` and Alpine's magics (`$el`, `$refs`, `$wire`) do not match. On main the dd counter finds 8; after this change 0. CLAUDE.md's Front-end build section now points at the budget instead of a line count.

## Checks

- Full suite locally: 2342 tests, OK.
- PHPStan: no errors. Baseline: removed the six entries for `SettingObserver` and the rewritten command, the `createContractOfferJson` entry, and one `Negated boolean expression` count for `VehicleRealGarantService` (both came from `getOffer`).
- Pint on the new test files and the rewritten command.
params.title: No dd() on a live path, and ratchets for what should only shrink
